# osm

## Provider

OpenStreetMap contributors

## Product

Mapped highway ways

## Coverage

Small query areas through Overpass

## Resolution

Native OSM way geometry

## Temporal coverage

Rolling snapshot at retrieval; timestamp retained

## Access method

Bounded anonymous Overpass request

## What it provides

Mapped road features with provider-native geometry, identifiers, and classes.

## Available CubeDynamics nouns

[roads](../nouns/roads.md)

## Current QA/certification status

Bounded real acquisition and offline checks passed for retained samples. Broader scientific review and sustained-load testing remain open; endpoint availability is independent. QA profile: `feature_line`. [Evidence and scope](../../data/source_projects/production.md).

## Serving revision / provenance information

Rolling; retain exact raw response for exact replay. No production serving revision assigned. Raw response hashes, request parameters, and source-specific metadata are preserved; a live refresh never overwrites an existing snapshot.

## Important limitations

5,000 features; 6 requests / 4 MB bodies / 90 s. Ways require a node inside the bbox: long crossing ways may be absent. Public Overpass is not a sustained application backend. No automatic road-class crosswalk.
